desc_en: A sartorial silhouette defined by a bold graphic motif. Crafted with attention to detail to deliver an impeccable drape. This blazer marries classical structure with a contemporary statement of style. Designed to command attention on any occasion with magnetic presence. Each piece is made to order to ensure exclusivity.

Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido para garantizar la exclusividad.
